storyCards.headline: I Wanna Rock: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Snoop Dogg's "I Wanna Rock" reached #41 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Wanna Rock" is the third official single from American rapper, Snoop Dogg's tenth studio album, Malice n Wonderland.

The song peaked at #41 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

I Wanna Rock was released in 2009.
